value.rationale: The intrinsic chromatic threshold of the canonical 7-vertex four-chromatic spindle motivates exact shortest paths, not just connectivity. Two distinct nonregular named-colour recolouring graphs unexpectedly have constant eccentricity, and granting one spare colour lowers the sharp worst-case 13 to 10. A complete natural finite metric baseline enables comparison of recolouring routes; no arbitrary slice or downstream theorem is asserted.
